d:
Get ready to go behind the scenes of the official party anthem “Phurr”
Watch exclusive BTS moments with Yo Yo Honey Singh, Kapil Sharma & Ayesha Khan as they bring this high-energy party track to life!
From fun on-set banter to electrifying dance rehearsals and music magic, this behind-the-scenes video shows you how the vibe of Phurr was created. Witness the teamwork, creativity, and unstoppable energy that turned this song into a party sensation.
If you love party songs, celebrity BTS, and Honey Singh’s swag mixed with Kapil Sharma’s charm, this one’s for you!
Song Title: PHURR
